chunks.text: We've talked about what orders are, and we've talked about what happens

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Let's talk now about how do the orders get to the exchange from you.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Well, here you are with your laptop connected to the internet, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: you've just entered an order to buy some stock.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Your buy order goes over the internet to your broker.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Your broker in turn is connected to several exchanges, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: the broker determines where to route your order based on information it knows about

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Let's suppose the exchanges we're looking at are New York Stock Exchange, NASDAQ, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: BATS.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: For the stock that you want to buy, each one of these exchanges has its own order book.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Your broker has a computer located at each exchange, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: it queries the computer, say, hey, look at the order book,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: tell me what the prices are there.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Queries that at all the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Your broker gathers and examines that information, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: based on that, routes your order to the exchange that has the best price.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Let's say that's New York Stock Exchange.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Your order enters the exchange, gets executed, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: the price comes back to your broker and forwarded back to you, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: you get a confirmation.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Now, it turns out that because this is happening constantly all the time,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: there's multiple brokers, hundreds of thousands, millions of people making orders,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: that the order books at each of these exchanges tends to be pretty similar.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: In other words, the prices don't differ much between one or another.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: And it's this sort of pressure that keeps prices the same across these different

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: exchanges.

chunks.text: Let's consider another scenario.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Suppose there's another client of this same brokerage, Joe, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: that Joe wants to sell some stock.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Well, the brokerage can observe, hey, I've got some clients who want to sell,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: some clients who want to buy.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: I can just make that exchange internally, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: I don't even need to go to the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: This can be advantageous for the broker, because a broker doesn't have to pay,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: now, fees to the exchanges for this transaction to occur.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: However, according to the law, both the seller and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: the buyer have to get prices that are at least as good as they would have gotten if

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: they had gone to an exchange.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: And eventually, at the end of the day,

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: this transaction has to be registered with one of the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Usually it's recorded at the exchange where that particular stock is homed.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: Let's consider one more example.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: In this case, Lisa also wants to sell some stock, but

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: she uses a different broker than you do.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: There's one more kind of entity out there called a dark pool that acts as an

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: intermediary between brokerages and exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: So the dark pool is looking at the order books of the various exchanges, and

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: they're often making predictions about which direction stocks are going to go.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: They actually pay the brokers for the privilege to look at the orders before

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: they go to the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: And if they see an advantageous trade, they'll go ahead and take it.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: So in this case, this sell might be routed through the dark pool from broker two

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: through to broker one.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: And again, the transaction never makes it to the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: In fact, these days, 80 to 90% of what they call retail traders' orders never make it

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: to the exchanges.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: They're either executed internally within a brokerage or filled using a dark pool.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: The brokerages and the dark pools argue that that's just fine because both partners in

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: this transaction are getting prices at least as good as they would get at the exchanges

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: and on the order books.

chunks.title: How orders get to the exchange
chunks.text: But they're saving money because they don't have to pay the exchange fees.
